description: Prepare an enquiry to the studio — acquisition, exhibition or press — and see exactly what would be sent. Nothing is sent at this step: the draft is held for two days, seen by nobody, and deleted unless it is confirmed. Show the details to the person named, and only if they agree to be contacted, send it with confirm_inquiry and the code this returns. Requires a way to reply and a description of the space or project.
